import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    public static long powMod(long a, long b) {
        long ret = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                ret = (ret * a) % MOD;
            }
            b >>= 1;
            a = (a * a) % MOD;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long p = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();

        if (k == 1) {
            System.out.println(powMod(p, p));
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        long[] w = new long[(int) p];
        for (long i = 1; i < p; i++) {
            w[(int) i] = (k * i) % p;
        }

        boolean[] vis = new boolean[(int) p];
        int cnt = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i < p; i++) {
            if (vis[i]) continue;
            int t = i;
            while (!vis[t]) {
                vis[t] = true;
                t = (int) w[t];
            }
            cnt++;
        }

        System.out.println(powMod(p, cnt));
        sc.close();
    }
}
